scope: Static link-local IPv6 DNS capture and GUID-resolved current-index restoration. Hosted contract regressions cover index changes, legacy zones, family activation and invalid-data refusal before effects.
limitations: Source mocks exercise GUID/index changes without qualifying physical hotplug or a real renumbered interface.
Native round trips and failure cases are scoped to fresh hosted Windows; failures and preparation refusals are retained verbatim as fixed public reports.
No raw runtime logs, DNS addresses, adapter identities, account information or private controller artifacts were read.
Signed installed lifecycle, reboot/power-loss, managed rollout, ordinary-user/operator/accessibility acceptance and sustained performance remain separate open gates.
The existing private writer/finalization architecture remains unchanged; its proposed replacement still requires the user selection recorded in the full continuation.
